doc.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Church playing and her Kansas radio show
summary: She played horn at church only on holidays, and Bryant recalls her Kansas radio show where she played with just a piano.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: When you guys got out here, you did continue your church affiliation, right?
You started playing your horn in church?
I didn’t play my horn in church, unless they were getting some Christmas and New Year’s and all of that stuff. I didn’t play every Sunday.
We forgot about your radio show in Kansas.
[cannot recall details.] I was a little star.
But it was just you and the piano then?
